title: Derived ringed-topos pullback preserves compatible central scalars
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $u:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D),B)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),A)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by sites small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Suppose given unital homomorphisms $s_A:R\to\Gamma(\mathcal C,A)$ and $s_B:R\to\Gamma(\mathcal D,B)$ such that the structural map $c:u^{-1}A\to B$ carries $u^{-1}s_A(r)$ to $s_B(r)$ for every $r\in R$. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] define $(r f)_U(x)=s_A(r)|_U f_U(x)$, and likewise using $s_B$. Equip the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(A),D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with the induced $R$-linear structures [def-weil-linear-category, lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. The canonical K-flat derived pullback $Lu^*:D(A)\to D(B)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback] is $R$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor]. In particular it sends the endomorphism induced by the actual scalar section $s_A(r)$ to that induced by $s_B(r)$; no flatness of $c$ is assumed.
